Cochin Shipyard Secures Repeat Order for Luxury Vessels

Cochin Shipyard has received a repeat order to build two luxury cruise vessels, with the contract valued between Rs 100 crore and Rs 250 crore. Following this announcement, shares of Cochin Shipyard saw a 5% increase. The company also has an order to build 40 ships.
